svg.text: A broken scanner produces exactly the same output as a safe target: zero findings. So an adapter always picks one of three levels: return [] when it ran and found nothing, raise ScanIntegrityError when it could not check, or fill coverage_gaps when it checked only part. The CI job "Contrato do silencio" checks the code
